{{Top|leg}}
'''Solo's End Run''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] tactic named after [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. It was commonly used in conjunction with the [[Sevari Sidestep]] and involved doubling back to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] while hidden in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] to avoid [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.
